name: Crossing - target fine on starboard bow
description:
Target is on own-ship's starboard bow at a fine angle (~20 deg relative). Own-ship must give way.

Additional, beyond the 22 Imazu problems: Imazu problem 2 samples a starboard crossing at only one bearing (~45 deg). This mission is the fine-bearing (~20 deg) point of a 3-point starboard sweep (with UM04/UM05) that tests whether give-way behaviour generalises across the bearing range instead of just Imazu's single sample.
pass_criteria: Own-ship is give-way: she alters course (normally to starboard) and/or speed early.
Own-ship avoids crossing ahead of the target if circumstances allow.
Minimum CPA stays above the safe-distance threshold.
